title: clypeola montana
intro: Clypeola montana, commonly known as Alpine Cress or Mountain Bladder Copepod, is a perennial plant belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support immune function and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Clypeola montana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various purposes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
